lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: You'll want the sourdough, everyone does, and you'll want to know why a stranger is asking about the block. Both answers are on the counter.

lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Three nights running, men out front with a measure. Port's buying the whole corner for a container yard. I'm the last freehold on it and the offer went down again this morning.

lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Offers go down when somebody knows the property's about to be worth less. There's only one thing that happens to a brick building to make it worth less.

choices.text: Then we sit the night shift with you.
Sell, and be somewhere else when it happens.
